children: Mateusz Żelek has joined Born2trade as Chief Product & Platform Officer, following a tenure of about two years as chief executive officer of RoboMarkets Polska.
Żelek announced the move on LinkedIn today (Monday). “Happy to share that I’m joining Born2trade as Chief Product & Platform Officer,” he wrote.

The move comes as Born2trade continues to expand its trading offering. In July, the broker rolled out prediction markets on the Match-Trader platform, giving clients access to event-based contracts alongside its existing CFD products. Match-Trade Technologies supplied the module.
From Match-Trade to RoboMarkets and Born2trade
Żelek previously spent about six years at Match-Trade Technologies, including more than four years as Deputy Head of Dealing and Broker Support.
Before joining Born2trade, he spent about two years as CEO of RoboMarkets Polska in Warsaw.
Earlier, Żelek spent about six years at Match-Trade Technologies. He joined the company as a Broker Support Junior Specialist before moving into the Deputy Head of Dealing and Broker Support role.
Żelek Moves From FX Dealing to Product
Before Match-Trade, he worked at Ebury for over a year as a Business Developer in Warsaw.
Earlier in his career, he spent about two years at eFinco sp. z o.o. as a foreign exchange dealer in the Warsaw metropolitan area.

His career has covered foreign exchange dealing, broker support, dealing operations, business development and executive management. His new role shifts his focus towards product and platform responsibilities.

Born2trade has recently added third-party technology to its trading offering. The broker launched a copy trading service using Brokeree Solutions’ Social Trading system. It also offers MetaTrader 5 and a proprietary platform built on Match-Trade infrastructure.
Born2trade operates under a licence from the Financial Services Commission of Mauritius and is registered in Saint Lucia.

title: Born2trade Names Former RoboMarkets Polska CEO as Product Chief
